grammar.purpose: Read large units rather than substituting English groups
grammar.explanation: 千 = 1,000; 万 = 10,000; 亿 = 100,000,000. Chinese large-number grouping uses 万 and 亿. 一万 is ten thousands; 一亿 is ten thousand 万. 二万 and 两万 can occur, while 两千 is common; do not turn 两万 into two thousand. Use explicit digits when checking a financial label. The large numbers here are reading practice, not this outing’s actual budget.

examples.zh: 一千是一百的十倍，一万是一千的十倍。
examples.py: yī qiān shì yī bǎi de shí bèi , yī wàn shì yī qiān de shí bèi .
examples.en: One thousand is ten hundreds; ten thousand is ten thousands.

examples.py: liǎng wàn shì èr shí gè yī qiān .

examples.zh: 一亿是一万万，不是一百万。
examples.py: yī yì shì yī wàn wàn , bù shì yī bǎi wàn .
examples.en: One hundred million is ten thousand ten-thousands, not one million.

commonMistakes.why: 万 denotes ten thousand; 千 denotes one thousand.

grammar.pattern: number + 多 + classifier / number + classifier + 多
grammar.purpose: Keep approximate counts and fractional extras separate
grammar.explanation: 十多个人 gives an integer count over ten, commonly in the teens. 一百多块 gives more than one hundred yuan without an exact total. 一个多小时 is more than one hour, normally less than two; 多 follows the duration classifier. 三斤多 is a little over three jin. These are approximate descriptions, not exact sums; the actual amount may need confirmation. Do not interpret 十多个人 as 10.5 people or 一个多小时 as more than ten hours.

examples.zh: 十多个人参加，不是正好十个。
examples.py: shí duō gè rén cān jiā , bù shì zhèng hǎo shí gè .
examples.en: More than ten people participate, not exactly ten.

examples.zh: 活动一个多小时，不是十多个小时。
examples.py: huó dòng yī gè duō xiǎo shí , bù shì shí duō gè xiǎo shí .
examples.en: The activity lasts a little over an hour, not more than ten hours.

examples.zh: 水果三斤多，钱一百多块，先问具体是多少。
examples.py: shuǐ guǒ sān jīn duō , qián yī bǎi duō kuài , xiān wèn jù tǐ shì duō shao .
examples.en: The fruit is a little over three jin and the cost over a hundred yuan; ask for exact amounts.

commonMistakes.why: Place 多 after 十 and before 个 for an approximate count of people.

dialogue.title: Three shares
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the real total and what is only reading practice.

lines.zh: 先数人数吧。
lines.py: xiān shǔ rén shù ba .
lines.en: Let us count the people first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 三个人，全到了。要买的东西不少，我先算一算。
lines.py: sān gè rén , quán dào le . yào mǎi de dōng xi bù shǎo , wǒ xiān suàn yī suàn .
lines.en: Three people, all here. There are quite a few things to buy; I will calculate first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 车票一部分，饭和水果一部分，一共多少？
lines.py: chē piào yī bù fèn , fàn hé shuǐ guǒ yī bù fèn , yī gòng duō shao ?
lines.en: Tickets are one part and food and fruit another; what is the total?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 全部一百二十块。分成三份，每人四十。
lines.py: quán bù yī bǎi èr shí kuài . fēn chéng sān fèn , měi rén sì shí .
lines.en: One hundred and twenty altogether. Three shares of forty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我收入不多，这次预算一百五十，够吗？
lines.py: wǒ shōu rù bù duō , zhè cì yù suàn yī bǎi wǔ shí , gòu ma ?
lines.en: My income is not large; I budgeted one hundred and fifty for this outing. Is that enough?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 够。正好付一百二十，还剩三十。
lines.py: gòu . zhèng hǎo fù yī bǎi èr shí , hái shèng sān shí .
lines.en: Yes. Pay exactly one hundred and twenty; thirty remains.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这家店卖水果。买一公斤，两斤，对吗？
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn mài shuǐ guǒ . mǎi yī gōng jīn , liǎng jīn , duì ma ?
lines.en: This shop sells fruit. One kilogram is two jin, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。五角是半块，别把角和块看成一样。
lines.py: duì . wǔ jiǎo shì bàn kuài , bié bǎ jiǎo hé kuài kàn chéng yī yàng .
lines.en: Yes. Five jiao is half a yuan; do not treat jiao and yuan as the same.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这张银行卡能用吗？我也带了现金。
lines.py: zhè zhāng yín háng kǎ néng yòng ma ? wǒ yě dài le xiàn jīn .
lines.en: Can I use this bank card? I also brought cash.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先问店里。今天每人花四十，不是四十万。
lines.py: xiān wèn diàn lǐ . jīn tiān měi rén huā sì shí , bù shì sì shí wàn .
lines.en: Ask the shop first. Today each person spends forty, not four hundred thousand.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哈哈。一千、一万、一亿，只是在练数字吧？
lines.py: hā hā . yī qiān , yī wàn , yī yì , zhǐ shì zài liàn shù zì ba ?
lines.en: Ha. One thousand, ten thousand and a hundred million are just number practice, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。十多个人和一个多小时也要分清，不能当今天的准确人数和时间。
lines.py: duì . shí duō gè rén hé yī gè duō xiǎo shí yě yào fēn qīng , bù néng dāng jīn tiān de zhǔn què rén shù hé shí jiān .
lines.en: Right. Distinguish more than ten people from over an hour too; neither is today’s exact count or time.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Every person pays the entire total
No, they still need to ask the shop
Yes, having a card proves acceptance
